changes: Clarifies only the native subgroup, exact point membership and norm action in relation H6-LATE-04-NATIVE-INDEX-AND-HEIGHT. The mass/Hecke relation and all other source conclusions are unchanged.
textual_status: The current definition3286–3291 names the native lattices and their index valuations without spelling out the group. The following is the explicit subgroup required by the genus-character construction. It is a clarification, not a claim that these words already appear there. It must not be replaced by the full Mordell–Weil group E(F_D).
definition: For D>1 put K_D=Q(sqrt(D h*)), F_D=Q(sqrt D,sqrt h*), and let tau be the nonidentity element of Gal(F_D/K_D). Define Gamma_D={P in E(F_D):tau(P)=-P}, and Lambda_D=Gamma_D/Gamma_D,tors. The native genus index at a known simple zero is the divisibility index of the class of the actual P_D in this rank-one free lattice. The rank-one premise is retained from the actual genus/analytic-rank construction; it is not deduced solely from height nonzero. For D=1 put F_D=K_D=Q(sqrt h*), Gamma_1=E(K_D), with its torsion-free quotient as the native lattice.
exact_membership: The unaveraged sum P_D=sum_[a] chi_h*(Norm a) pi(x_D^[a]) transforms under the class-field Galois group by this exact quadratic character: applying an Artin element permutes the index set, and reindexing multiplies the whole sum by its character value. The kernel fixes P_D, so P_D belongs to E(F_D); the nonidentity element over K_D acts by -1 when D>1. This is equality of points, not only an equality modulo torsion or after applying4B. It uses the stated CM reciprocity action and the same Q-defined parametrization. For D=1 the character is trivial and the sum is K_D-rational.
twist_identification: Let iota_D:E^(D)->E be the standard isomorphism over Q(sqrt D), with g(iota_D)=chi_D(g)iota_D. For P in Gamma_D, tau(iota_D^(-1)P)=chi_D(tau)iota_D^(-1)tau(P)=iota_D^(-1)P. Thus iota_D identifies E^(D)(K_D) exactly with Gamma_D. It identifies E^(D)(Q) with the rational D-character subgroup inside Gamma_D.
norm_argument: Under this identification, let sigma be the nonidentity element of Gal(K_D/Q), represented for D>1 by changing sqrt(h*) while fixing sqrt D. The retained rational character decomposition has D and h* components; the latter has rank zero by the forward theorem. Consequently sigma fixes the torsion-free class of each Q in E^(D)(K_D). The point Q+sigma(Q) is actually Q-rational, and its class is2[Q]. Therefore the image of E^(D)(Q) in Lambda_D contains2 Lambda_D. Since Lambda_D has rank one, its index is1 or2. Torsion need not vanish to make this conclusion. For D=1 the same argument uses E(K_D), ordinary conjugation, the rational E component and the rank-zero h* twist. The multiplier4B used later to obtain exact D-character points is independent of this norm-index proof.
boundaries: The genus-character/CM reciprocity statement is a separate actual input, including the current residual02 comparison.
The rational D-component rank-one premise and h* rank-zero premise remain supplied; no rank inference from nontorsion alone.
The index≤2 result is for Lambda_D and its rational D-twist subgroup, not all of E(F_D).
No equality of integral lattices, no torsion index and no global source-closure claim.
